children: Overview
China ophthalmic medical group's H1 revenue rose 1.8% yr/yr, driven by consumer services growth
Net profit for H1 fell 16.1% yr/yr, with net margin narrowing to 13.1%
Gross profit margin declined due to lower medical insurance pricing and higher costs
Outlook
Company expects steady demand growth for ophthalmic services due to economic growth and aging population
Chaoju Eye Care plans to expand network in North China and Yangtze River Delta through acquisitions and new hospitals
Company aims to leverage clinical expertise to increase market share in consumer ophthalmic services
Result Drivers

CONSUMER OPHTHALMIC SERVICES - Co said revenue growth was mainly driven by consumer ophthalmic services, which benefited from increased procedure volume and higher pricing following the introduction of SMILE-PRO equipment
BASIC OPHTHALMIC SERVICES - Co said revenue from basic ophthalmic services declined due to reduced medical insurance pricing, though increased patient visits partially offset the impact
EQUIPMENT AND CONSUMABLE SALES - Sales revenue from medical equipment and consumables rose, reflecting expansion of the supply chain sales business
